The `verisci/evaluate/lib/data.py` and `metrics.py` files are unmodified upstream
SciFact evaluation code from https://github.com/allenai/scifact (master, downloaded
2026-10-11). Source URLs and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in each run's provenance.
The upstream licensing notice is reproduced in LICENSE.md (Apache 2.0 for code,
CC BY 4.0 for claim annotations, ODC-By 1.0 for abstracts). Only the in-memory wrapper
in `scifact_project/metrics.py` is ours; scoring is executed by the original code.
